list.question: What kind of healthcare providers is Clinvvo built for?
list.answer: Clinvvo is designed for clinics, hospitals, and digital health providers offering services across any speciality. From primary care and sexual health to psychiatry and speech therapy - our flexible modules adapt to your care model.

list.question: How does Clinvvo improve clinical efficiency?
list.answer: Clinvvo is an end-to-end platform, from digital triage and patient communication to clinical workflows and AI-powered documentation. We don't just offer isolated AI tools; we support the full care journey with integrated solutions that reduce administrative burden and let providers focus on what matters most: delivering care.

list.question: Is Clinvvo compliant with European regulations?
list.answer: Yes, Clinvvo is fully GDPR-compliant and built to meet regional healthcare requirements, including secure data storage, patient consent workflows, and integrations with national EHRs.

list.question: Does Clinvvo support different languages and localizations?
list.answer: Yes, Clinvvo supports region and language specific configurations. We currently serve providers across Sweden and broader Europe.

list.question: How long does it take to go live with Clinvvo?
list.answer: Depending on your scope and configuration needs, providers can typically launch within 2 to 6 weeks. Our team supports onboarding, customization, and training every step of the way.
